capabilities: Link prose to specific lines or ranges of an id'd code block in the same note
Highlight referenced lines on hover and scroll-and-flash them on click in reading view and Live Preview
Render code block headers with title, line numbers, and a view source link to GitHub
Copy, paste, and insert references through commands, with prompts to add an id to a fence
Validate a note's references, listing broken references and duplicate ids
extras: Not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README gives BRAT and manual install paths. Releases carry GitHub build provenance attestations with verification instructions. README states the plugin makes no network calls and never reads the clipboard.
motivation: The author publishes notes from his vault with a static site generator and designed the syntax so code references survive publishing to the web.
problem: When writing about code in a note, readers lose track of which lines of a code block a sentence is talking about, and links can't point at exact lines.

relations.evidence: view source ↗ link when the block has source="owner/repo@ref:path" (GitHub)

summary: Code-reference plugin that links prose to specific lines of an id'd code block, with hover highlighting, click-to-jump, code block headers, and GitHub source links.
